parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights for my company, and I am the licensed person responsible for each one. I decide which drone flies and along which way, and I sign off a flight before it leaves, though our policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us. Several dispatchers plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight if needed. I need help finding out which of our drones could get to where a job starts, and I work with deliveries that carry a load from one site to another and inspections that take a drone with the right sensors to a list of points in a set order and bring it back.
